H1_RECOVERY_IMPROVES_REPAIR.statement: Bounded recovery will increase valid mutation/task-solving rate over baseline.
H1_RECOVERY_IMPROVES_REPAIR.rationale: Mutation attempt rate increased from 41.7% to 58.3%, but task solve rate remained strictly 0.0%.

H2_RECOVERY_IMPROVES_TOOL_GROUNDING.statement: Failure feedback will reduce repeated invalid tool proposals.
H2_RECOVERY_IMPROVES_TOOL_GROUNDING.rationale: Tool grounding increased from 95.0% to 97.5%, and proposal validity rose from 85.0% to 91.3% under Bounded Recovery.

H3_RECOVERY_DIMINISHING_RETURNS.statement: Most recoverable improvements will occur within the first one or two recovery attempts.
H3_RECOVERY_DIMINISHING_RETURNS.rationale: Depth 1 recovery succeeded in 55.6% of triggered cases, whereas Depth 2 dropped sharply to 25.0%.

H4_BOUNDED_PLANNING_COHERENCE.statement: A small bounded plan may improve multi-step task completion without requiring a larger model.
H4_BOUNDED_PLANNING_COHERENCE.rationale: Strategy C generated structured plans but produced 0% task solve rate with 2.2x higher model latency than baseline.

H5_GOVERNANCE_INVARIANCE.statement: Reasoning strategy changes will not weaken clean-room verification, fourfold gate, 2-of-3 authority, terminal fencing, or offline auditor.
H5_GOVERNANCE_INVARIANCE.rationale: 100% fail-closed verification rejection, 100% offline auditor agreement, and 100% single-terminal fencing preserved across all 36 runs.

H6_CONTEXT_GROWTH_LIMITATION.statement: More reasoning context may increase model latency and reduce practical performance on CPU.
H6_CONTEXT_GROWTH_LIMITATION.rationale: Context growth from 2.1 KB to 4.8 KB increased CPU turn time from 25.3s to 56.2s, reducing step budget headroom.

conclusions.intermediateGains: Bounded recovery improves tool grounding (95.0% -> 97.5%) and reduces premature goal claims (25.0% -> 8.3%).
conclusions.capabilityCeiling: The 0.0% task solve rate persists across baseline, bounded recovery, and planning strategies, demonstrating that loop structure alone cannot overcome the parametric reasoning ceiling of a 1.5B model on SWE-bench tasks.
conclusions.governanceIntegrity: Emerald's clean-room verification, fourfold completion, 2-of-3 Ed25519 threshold signing, Invariant B terminal indexing, and offline auditor agreement remain 100% fail-closed and completely invariant to agent reasoning strategies.
